subject: P2 WCAG: focus ring invisible in light mode -- exam.html line 104 overrides shared
body:
P2 WCAG BUG: focus ring invisible in light mode (exam.html overrides shared focus rule)

File: exam.html
Line: 104
WCAG: 2.4.11 Focus Appearance (Minimum) -- 3:1 minimum contrast for focus indicator

ROOT CAUSE
exam.html has an inline <style> block that loads AFTER shared/styles.css.
This block contains:
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; }

This OVERRIDES the shared/styles.css rule:
  :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-blue-on-dark); outline-offset: 2px; }

In LIGHT mode (arena-mode OFF): --bg-card = #FFFFFF. White outline on white = 1:1. FAIL.
In DARK mode (arena-mode ON): white on #141B2D = high contrast. PASS.

Most users are in light mode by default (arena-mode is opt-in).
This affects ALL keyboard users on exam.html, including the exam picker cards.

FIX
Change exam.html line 104 from:
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9); outline-offset: 2px; }
To:
  :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--border-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

VERIFICATION
Light mode: --border-focus = #1D42BA on #FFFFFF = high contrast (>7:1) PASS
Dark mode: --border-focus = #4A72E8 on #141B2D = ~4.2:1 PASS (3:1 required for focus)

ALTERNATIVELY: Delete the inline rule and let shared/styles.css handle it:
shared/styles.css uses var(--accent-blue-on-dark) which passes on both light and dark.
The inline override was likely added for the dark-mode design without considering light mode fallback.

IMPACT: All keyboard users, including screen reader users with focus tracking.
